gloss: to buy up, to purchase outright

definitions.gloss: to buy up, to purchase outright
definitions.explanation: To purchase something outright, often used for buying back, buying used goods, or acquiring something in full.

examples.japanese: {中古|ちゅうこ}の{本|ほん}を{買|か}い{取|と}る。
この{店|みせ}ではブランド{品|ひん}を{高|たか}く{買|か}い{取|と}ってくれる。
examples.english: This shop buys brand-name goods at good prices.

examples.japanese: {不要|ふよう}になった{家具|かぐ}をリサイクルショップに{買|か}い{取|と}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had a secondhand shop buy the furniture I no longer needed.

notes:
{買|か}い{取|と}る means to purchase something outright, often used for secondhand goods, trade-ins, and buybacks.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{買|か}い{取|と}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {高|たか}く{買|か}い{取|と}る: to buy at a high price
- {安|やす}く{買|か}い{取|と}る: to buy at a low price
- {買|か}い{取|と}ってもらう: to have someone buy (from you)
- {買|か}い{取|と}り{専門店|せんもんてん}: specialty buyback shop

RELATED TERMS:
- {買取|かいとり}: purchase, buyback (noun form)
- {買取|かいとり}{価格|かかく}: buyback price
- {下取|したど}り: trade-in

USAGE:
Very common in the context of secondhand shops (リサイクルショップ), used bookstores ({古本屋|ふるほんや}), and electronics resellers. Signs reading {高価|こうか}{買取|かいとり} (we buy at high prices) are common.
